what_it_does: Sensors that measure capacitance (like touchscreens or proximity sensors) need to be converted to digital numbers. Existing approaches either saturate (fail) with large capacitance inputs or take too long counting oscillation cycles. This hybrid converter combines two techniques: it uses period modulation (a time-domain method that handles wide ranges) for the rough measurement and SAR (successive approximation register—a binary-search-like method) for fine resolution, achieving high speed (6.1 microseconds) and wide input range (over 18 nanofarads) without saturation issues. Think of it as doing a coarse measurement first, then zooming in for details.
